title: Ethiopia again demands access to the Red Sea as tensions with neighbors escalate
description: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed is reiterating his country’s demand for Red Sea access, escalating tensions with neighboring coastal nations who maintain that governance of the sea rests with them. The dispute adds to existing regional conflicts over the Tigray region and the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam.

title: Palestinian families evacuated from West Bank settler violence return home
description: Six Palestinian families, displaced for over two months due to violence by Israeli settlers, have returned to their homes in the West Bank town of Tell. Announced by the Palestinian Authority, their return follows repeated attacks on Tell, primarily from the Havat Gilad settlement, highlighting the ongoing issue of settler aggression in the region.

description: LONDON: Two Israeli journalists were barred from attending a post-match press conference following a chaotic Republic of Ireland media session ahead of the team’s UEFA Nations League match against Israel. title: Trump says ready to ‘help’ Russia with reported plague
description: WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump said on Monday that the United States was looking “very strongly” at a reported plague case in Russia and was ready to help Moscow with the situation. “We’re looking at it very strongly, we just heard about it,” Trump told reporters when asked what Washington was going to do about the risk of pneumonic plague coming from Russia. “We’ll help them, we’ll help them as much as we can.”
